summary: A Quote client on an equity whose tk snapshot carries no change (pc): the frame has no change_percent, never one worked out from the close. A tf delta then brings pc, and a later delta with only a new price keeps it, as a partial update does.

notes: The web forwards only pc as change_percent and percent_change (aliceblue_adapter.py `_quote_fields`), so the desktop works no change out without one (lead rule no-derived-change, as for Noren and 5paisa).
A tf leaves out what has not changed: docs/port/market-data-frames.md, Partial-update feeds.

deviations.reason: The web sends AliceBlue's feed time ft as ltt in epoch seconds, an integer since web #2473 (aliceblue_adapter.py `_feed_time`, `_quote_fields`); the docs key ltt is epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md).
